sloka: सा हृता राक्षसेन्द्रेण रावणेन दुरात्मना ।मायाम् आस्थाय विपुलाम् वात दुर्दिन संकुलाम् ॥३-६८-९॥
transliteration: sā hṛtā rākṣasendreṇa rāvaṇena durātmanā ।māyām āsthāya vipulām vāta durdina saṁkulām ॥3-68-9॥

translations.english: Ravana, the lord of the demons created violent winds through terrific magic and whisked her away in the sky.
